en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of an old European town with dense, steep-roofed houses in the foreground, a large round defensive tower on the left, and a tall neo‑Gothic church with a slender spire and clock in the center distance. Trees form a band beyond the inner town, with multi‑story residential blocks further back. The caption "Freiberg i. S." is printed in red at the top left, and a vertical red imprint with a publisher's name and number appears along the right edge.
